'''Lara Ayellan''' is a girl in [[Emond's Field]].

==History==
When [[Moiraine Damodred]] mentioned that there was more than [[Egwene al'Vere]] in the [[Two Rivers]] who could channel, Egwene asks if it was [[Kari Thane]] or Lara.
